input.title: Restore authored pause artwork, caption and shade compositing
input.body:
## Summary

Restore the source pause layout and darkening layer: preserve padded artwork, use the authored caption field, and retain the static root label beneath the saved bitmap.

```text
Source display order
  root1559 → static text1558
  saved bitmap → 19 blur passes
  button layer → raw alpha settles at1.03125
    shade1096 → alpha64 × raw parent = effective66
    padded title/orbs
    caption1560 → font503, size20, authored RECT/ascent
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** CSS clamped the44px padded play raster into its40px button; the title and other orbs were also clamped. The17px caption was about11px too high and15px too narrow, and the separate static root label was missing.
  **After:** All five native raster widths retain their prepared extents. Repeatable HUD metadata supplies root placement/glyph metrics and caption geometry/font; supplied artwork stays browser-local.
- **Before:** The named-piece importer omitted the unnamed black64/255 rectangle at depth1. Paused colors differed from the original by as much as41 RGB levels across six quiet median samples.
  **After:** The source shade and matrix are imported. Its opacity uses the raw shared fade alpha before CSS clamping. The maximum error at those six samples falls to2 levels; this is a bounded comparison, not full-frame equality.
- Reference primitive replays confirm alpha179 after19 blur calls, normal bitmap source-over, and a Sprite alpha getter of1.03125 after22 additions of0.05. A64-alpha child over white renders189, proving effective alpha66. These are project-authored primitives, not direct original game-bitmap readback or Adobe execution.
- Same-pose browser controls verify initial root occlusion, settled root paint, exact shade darkening with both settled and closing parent alpha, and caption hover/off restoration. Bitmap reversal and Settings/Info transitions remain covered. Native caption bounds223/392…323/408 remain within one pixel of original223/392…323/407.
- Formatting, TypeScript, **750 unit tests / 7,473 assertions**, production build and **six native/mock pause browser cases without skips** passed on the final changes. Seven fresh public-input native captures had zero page errors; galleries were inspected. Reimport is byte-identical and only adds the pause root/caption/shade data.
- Small color/interpolation and approximately one-pixel raster differences, general per-leaf parent transforms on other translucent UI, synchronized timing and Adobe/full-game parity remain documented work.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revertible UI/asset preparation change; no storage migration or bundled original media.

**Blast Radius:** pause

Affects image extents, caption geometry and source root/shade composition. Shade paint uses the existing clock without changing captured pixels or history. Existing input and deliberate retired-service omissions remain covered.
